goal: Deploy verified encrypted key persistence to existing local backend, preserve configuration, make one-time existing-profile key entry available.
scope: Controlled replacement of exact owned backend
Optional one ordinary restart after user saves key in UI
forbidden: Vault or full SQLite bytes/payload reads
One-off temporary XDG or secret directory override
Unrelated process signals or restart loops

steps.details: Verify all input pins, R492 review source pins, 56 focused + 39 adjacent + 13 frontend passes and final style/typecheck. Revalidate PID 300100 uid1000 starttime8283996 cwd/repo, known uvicorn module, loopback8000 listener, and frontend159968 starttime8153269. Inspect only allowlisted command tokens; never dump argv/environ. Preserve parent1520 and shared systemd scope. Any mismatch stops before signaling.

steps.action: Freeze nonsecret before-state and launch contract
steps.details: Bounded GET /health and /api/v1/model-control/{profiles,runtime,capabilities}, each timeout5s one request. Retain only allowlisted profile config, IDs, active, secret flags/kind and selected runtime identity; exclude api_key and last_test. Assert three expected IDs and active profile-4f24f5330ad644ad. Confirm candidate SQLite path exists regular and read-only SELECT profile_id and active_profile_id only matches live IDs; no payload/blob, vault or DB backup/hash. Verify stable real HOME/XDG and safe default directory ancestors using lstat only. Prepare detached launcher and receipts before stopping.

Immediately recheck full identity and retain pidfd if supported. SIGTERM only that PID via pidfd where possible, wait <=30s. No SIGKILL/group/parent signals. If still alive or unexpected listener appears, stop. Launch exactly one new backend using absolute .venv Python and argv specified below, cwd repo, start_new_session=True, stdin DEVNULL, stdout/stderr to dedicated logs. Record new pid/starttime/uid and known argv. Do not invoke combined launcher that would create another Vite or initialize other runtime state.

At most10 /health attempts timeout2s with <=1s spacing, overall30s. Then one bounded GET each profiles/runtime/capabilities. Require same three IDs, same nonsecret config and active ID; all returned storekind ENCRYPTED_FILE, actual secret_present false expected before user save; advertised modes ENCRYPTED_FILE and SESSION_ONLY. Exclude historical session presence/kind from config equality. READY alone is not credential validation. Verify new PID owns8000 and original Vite159968 remains. Unexpected present=true is not migration proof: record and stop for provenance review without reading vault.

Optional one GET http://127.0.0.1:5173/models timeout5s plus bounded browser inspection of empty existing-profile key modal. Do not inspect password properties, type a key, submit or capture credential-bearing screenshots. Preserve Vite; no build needed for verified Vite source serving. Explain user saves same key once via existing active row 保存/更新密钥, with all model metadata retained. End ready_for_one_time_key_entry if user has not saved; no waiting/poll loop.

steps.action: Conditional persistence proof after direct user UI save
steps.details: Only after user save acknowledgement/explicit user confirmation, one metadata GET must show active profile secret_present=true and ENCRYPTED_FILE. No key reading/export. Perform at most one additional ordinary restart with same validated launcher/DB/HOME/XDG and identical PID admission, then metadata true + same config/active proves store recovery. Record persisted_key_survives_restart only on this evidence. If user does not enter during task, mark verification pending and finish ready_for_one_time_key_entry; never request key in chat.

Keep exact raw operational logs and filtered metadata receipts, timing/exit/status, source pins and command manifest. No secrets/full env/DB/vault bytes in artifacts/Git. Report software108pass separately from live transition/persistence. Commit and push only named R489–R493 source/test/docs/reports already in authorized scope and verify local/upstream/remote SHA; preserve unrelated nested worktrees. New root cause or unexpected failure requires next Astra before repair.

launch.xdg: Use only stable actual-user absolute XDG_DATA_HOME if positively established; otherwise actual account standard unset/empty XDG uses /home/ningyd/.local/share. No temporary/test XDG. Record selected nonsecret base for future restart; do not read target process environ.

recovery: Before SIGTERM failure leaves old service untouched. After SIGTERM the memory key is unrecoverable; do not claim rollback can restore it. If new process fails health/metadata, terminate only the still identity-matched new process, wait <=30s, keep logs/DB/frontend intact, and report bounded stopped state requiring new Astra diagnosis. No automatic retry, old-source rollback, vault reset, fallback or secret migration.
acceptance: ready_for_one_time_key_entry: new backend healthy, config preserved, encrypted capability/default truthful, existing UI action ready; key not yet persisted
persisted_key_survives_restart: conditional user save then one restart proves actual presence; no model validity or nominal research claim
